architecture.materialization: controller-v2.js.txt is an inert CommonJS module read/compiled by reviewed harness; contains preflight, typed decoding and fixed historical sequence; analysis-v2.py.txt retains separately hashed original analysis source, never executed in this assignment
architecture.schema: Use pinned server.py result shape and real transcript. Batch results bind exact command/order/count, error false and typed output; inspect outer isError and structured errors. Accept content-only or structured-only representations when semantically valid per actual API/observed wrappers; if both present require agreement. Start/stop use their own text-JSON result schemas. Session IDs are opaque nonempty returned values; conflicts/errors reject, not arbitrary new IDs.
architecture.stop_reason: Retained attach decodes stopped with unknown signal and cannot satisfy required SIGINT. Only explicit received status from matching status-query command can establish S02; echoes, S05 and unknown reject. Subsequent continuation requires its matching stopped reason, not just PC.
architecture.identity: Preserve source/byte/PAR oracle and caps; mock validator is labeled conditional. Count actual requested/completed read commands and bytes; no unconditional IDENTITY_PASS or hardcoded read totals. Validate required final identity and exact handoff acknowledgement/process fields.
architecture.ownership: Record session/launch intent before awaits, track ambiguous host sessions and unknown child ownership, inspect every cleanup acknowledgement; never clear unresolved ownership. Reserve cleanup budget; deadline failure returns explicit unresolved state, never implies cancellation.
architecture.evidence: Adapter preflight reserves a unique attempt namespace exclusively before tool/session activity. Preserve historical paths. Finalization must be acknowledged; result differentiates controller assertion, setup failure, missing coverage, cleanup failure and evidence failure. Reused namespace rejects without writing old results.
architecture.clock: Injected monotonic clock with absolute phase start/work/total deadlines; no fresh budget per callback. Virtual scheduling may resolve stalled mock requests at deadline but cannot represent real process cancellation. No service contract emulation claim.
architecture.analysis_limit: Original Python analysis/guard/window CLI remain unqualified. A typed mocked analysis result is conditional wiring only; unsupported pixel replay and host FPS stay unsupported. No activation-order repair in excluded helper.
